release_validation.methodology_change: PLFS sampling methodology was revamped from January 2025 and the survey cycle changed from July-June to January-December. MoSPI states that 2025 estimates should be considered carefully when compared with estimates released through December 2024.

anomalies.description: MoSPI introduced a revamped PLFS sampling design from January 2025 and changed the survey period to January-December. The 2025 report cautions against treating 2025 and earlier PLFS estimates as strictly comparable without methodological treatment.
anomalies.resolution: Preserve the 2022-2024 values contained in the 2025 release as source-defined historical observations, flag the 2025 methodology boundary, and do not claim an uninterrupted comparable series across the break.
